messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 3571112222 - tool-exec latency & error spike detected on /v1/invoke-tool (p95 latency > 1200ms, errors 5% over 3m). Paging eng-sre.
sre-oncall: seeing it. p95 up across the cluster and queue depth rising. looks like external tool invocations are the hot path.
infra-engineer-joel: confirmed, spots on worker nodes showing high outbound connections to agent-hosts. throughput for fncall path doubled. logs show many parallel actionexec requests from lower-tier tokens.
runtime-lead-anya: ok, immediate mitigation options: 1) global rate cap on toolcall path 2) disable structured output / function-call shape to force text-only fallback 3) drop free-tier toolcalls to 0rps 4) scale up, but that will take ~12m to spin GPUs.
sre-oncall: prioritize quick mitigation. prefer config changes we can roll back fast. propose: set route cap to 12rps, and disable structured output for plan=free and plan=dev for now. apply a soft 429 for excess.
infra-engineer-joel: I can push that. command: `rbctl route update --name=toolcall --rate-limit=12/s --burst=24` then `rbctl feature toggle --name=structured_output --off --selector="plan in (free,dev)"`
product-ops-lin: quick note: disabling structured output will break our 'connector' customers relying on JSON schema. need to notify a subset. Can we do canary by tenant tag before global off?
runtime-lead-anya: good catch. do a tenant-scoped first: `rbctl feature toggle --name=structured_output --off --selector="tenant_tag:nonpaid" --duration=15m` then monitor. if mitigation holds, expand.
sre-oncall: doing the tenant-scoped toggle now. patch request in logs: `PATCH /admin/features/structured_output {"enabled":false,"selector":"tenant_tag:nonpaid","expires_in":"15m"}`
infra-engineer-joel: route cap applied. monitoring. p95 has started to drop from 1250ms -> 800ms.
runtime-lead-anya: also enable fallback to text-only agent proxies: `runtime-config set toolcall.fallback_mode=text-only` so agent invocations avoid heavy JSON serializations.
product-ops-lin: drafting customer note for impacted tiers. short message: "We're temporarily restricting structured/JSON tool outputs for non-paid plans to preserve platform reliability. Paid customers unaffected." share status page link after.
status-bot: STATUSPAGE POST: "Investigating elevated latency on tool invocation path. Mitigation in progress. More details soon." (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3571112222)
sre-oncall: handing off to anya for runtime tuning and to monitor for 30m. I'll stay on the thread for escalation.
runtime-lead-anya: monitoring traces. after tenant toggle, error rate fell to 1.2% and p95 ~520ms. good signal. will keep structured_output off for nonpaid for 30m and reassess.
infra-engineer-joel: adding a temporary quota throttle to prevent token abuse: `quota update --selector="plan:free" --toolcall-per-minute=30` — applied.
product-ops-lin: will send an in-product banner to free users: "Temporary restriction on structured tool outputs to improve performance. Expected duration ~30-60m." queued.
sre-oncall: quick sanity: any major customers hit? check enterprise tag.
runtime-lead-anya: enterprise tenants unaffected, we scoped correctly. one mid-market customer on dev plan got 429s — CS notified.
product-ops-lin: CS message drafted and sent to affected mid-market contact. copying them on status page.
sre-oncall: good. timeline note for postmortem: root cause unknown yet — likely upstream agent-host saturation + high parallelism from test bots. keep feature off until we confirm root cause and put throttles in product rules.
runtime-lead-anya: schedule: keep mitigations for 30m, gather traces, if stable revert in 30m. if errors climb again, escalate to capacity scale (which is heavier).
infra-engineer-joel: saving logs and diffs for runbook: `git commit -m "temp cap & structured_output off for nonpaid"`
status-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATE: "Mitigation applied: rate limiting + structured output restriction for non-paid plans. Latency improving. Monitoring." (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3571112222)
sre-oncall: :white_check_mark: closing paging for now. Anya, you own the postmortem and rollback plan. I'll create the incident ticket and link the actions.
runtime-lead-anya: noted. will gather traces + tenant request logs and propose a longer-term policy: adaptive per-tenant toolcall limits and agent-side backpressure.
product-ops-lin: will follow up on customer comms and update the internal runbook with the tenant-scoped toggle steps.
sre-oncall: thanks everyone. will reconvene if metrics deviate. leaving thread open until rollback.
